_about: CNCF-hosted co-located events at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon NA 2026 (Salt Palace, Monday Nov 9), copied from the LF co-located schedule (Sessionize export) on Nov 8, 2026 at 3:12 PM MST. One entry per talk, shaped like schedule.json's sessions, plus the events, their breaks and the Evening Reception. All times are MST (UTC-07:00, zone America/Denver). Registration and coat check are left out on purpose. Generated by scripts/fetch_colocated.py: rules in _rules, source and counts in _meta, merge notes in _integration.

_meta.sourceData: Sessionize 'All' export embedded in the page as <script type="application/json" class="sched-data"> (Sessionize event ayajbd6b, https://cncf-hosted-co-located-events-north-america-2026.sessionize.com).
_meta.fetchedFrom: saved copy of the page (--offline); fetchedAt = the file's modification time

_rules: Times: Sessionize startsAt/endsAt are local wall-clock times without an offset. They are America/Denver, so they get -07:00 (MST; DST ended on Nov 1).

Events: the 11 event items of the 'All Sessions' category. key = group key = 'colo-' + the event's LF page slug. start/end = first talk start to last talk end (talks only, not breaks). mainRoom = the room with the most talks; rooms = every room with talks, main room first. supersedes = the all-day placeholder in schedule.json (category colo, note 'All-Access pass') with the same name, which the event card replaces; infoUrl and passNote come from that placeholder, and halfDay comes from its '(half day)' title.
Talks: category 'colo', group {key, title: event name}, coloEvent = coloEvents[0] = the event key, note null.

Breaks ('☕ Breaks'): category 'log', group null, renamed to schedule.json's house style ('AM Break'/'PM Break' -> '☕ Coffee Break', 'Lunch' -> '🍲 Lunch'). coloEvents = every event the break is tagged with; Sessionize staggers breaks per group of events. coloEvent = that event when there is exactly one, else null.

Experiences ('🎉 Experiences'): ordinary sessions for the day's time blocks. Category 'soc', group null, coloEvent null, coloEvents empty. This is deliberate: the source tags the Evening Reception with all 11 events (it is open to every co-located attendee, as its title says), but it belongs in the day's time blocks, not repeated inside 11 event cards, and its 18:30 end must not keep finished cards alive.
Omitted (listed in 'omitted'): registration and coat check, including both Nov 8 items. schedule.json leaves these out on purpose. Talks whose title is marked *CANCELED* are omitted too.

Rooms: each source room maps to the rooms.json room on the same level with the same name, sections in any order ('Grand Ballroom IG' = GI, '251 A-C' = 251AC, '151' = Room 151). Non-room places get new position-less rooms in 'rooms' (FOY, LCH4). 'Lower & Upper Mezzanine' (the Evening Reception) maps to UM, the Upper Mezzanine: the app shows 'Upper Mezzanine', and Directions work because UM has a position. Room codes stay rooms.json codes where one fits; a positioned copy of UM would add a duplicate place to the Directions 'From' picker.

Text: titles and names are HTML-unescaped, NFC-normalised and whitespace-collapsed; Unicode is kept. Speaker names are Sessionize fullName with a stray trailing '-' dropped ('Flynn -' -> 'Flynn', as in schedule.json). tagline = tagLine, or else 'Speaker Title, Company' from questionAnswers. A tagLine that starts by repeating the speaker's name loses it ('Alex Van Boxel, Principal System Architect at Collibra' -> 'Principal System Architect at Collibra'), because the app already shows the name.

Descriptions: Sessionize HTML (

,
,

    /
    1. , , /) is converted to the markdown subset that details.json uses and DescriptionFormat renders: blank-line paragraphs, '- ' list items, [text](url) or bare URLs, *em*/**strong**, with a literal \ * _ [ < backslash-escaped. Text is otherwise kept as Sessionize has it (e.g. '--' stays '--'; the LF website's WordPress typography turns it into '—'), the same as details.json.

Underscore repair: Sessionize turns a speaker's snake_case into emphasis ('build_id … build_id' arrives as 'buildid … buildid', so the LF page shows 'buildid … buildid' with italics between). Emphasis that opens straight after a letter or digit is turned back into literal underscores ('build\_id … build\_id'). The repaired session ids are listed in _meta.underscoreRepairs (on Nov 8 only 1269782, ArgoCon, whose same paragraph later says 'build_id-scoped').
slidesUrl: the session's 'Presentation Slides' answer (a sessionize.com/download link), as in schedule.json. null when none was uploaded.
topic: the session's item in its event's own topic category ('<event> Topics'; for Cloud Native AI + Inference Day the category is just the event name). null when none.

anthropicSpeakers: every speaker here whose tagLine or 'Company' answer mentions Anthropic (schedule.json's list is the KubeCon speakers whose details.json tagline mentions Anthropic), plus anyone in schedule.json's anthropicSpeakers who speaks here.
officialUrl: the page's own per-session link ('<page>?id=<id>', the same as its sess-link anchors and JSON-LD). A session the page doesn't link to falls back to its event's LF page.
Ids: Sessionize session ids. Any id that collides with schedule.json is prefixed 'c'.

isMine / hasAnthropicSpeaker: precomputed like schedule.json (default speaker = schedule.json 'me'; Anthropic = schedule.json's anthropicSpeakers plus this file's). The app recomputes them at runtime.
_integration: Assets: the app loads data from app/src/main/assets only; copy data/colocated.json and data/colocated_details.json there.

Decoding: the top level decodes with ScheduleFileDto (sessions, anthropicSpeakers, fieldNotes, timeZone) and RoomsFileDto (rooms); 'events' needs its own DTO. colocated_details.json's 'details' is Map<String, DetailDto>. Every other key is ignored by the app's Json (ignoreUnknownKeys).

Details: merge colocated_details.json's 'details' into the bundled details map (repo.details), lazily like details.json: they are a separate file so the start-up parse of colocated.json doesn't read them. These ids are plain digits, so DetailsRepository.isKubeConId() matches them: never live-fetch or disk-cache event == 'colocated' sessions (the live fetch would hit the main KubeCon Sessionize event, uo948i5p).
Anthropic: repo.anthropicSpeakers = schedule.json's anthropicSpeakers + this file's.

Day view: leave colo groups (talks) and co-located breaks out of the time blocks; they live in the event cards. The experience (Evening Reception) is an ordinary time-block session. Hide the 'supersedes' placeholders.
Search: add the event name (group.title) to the search haystack so 'argocon' finds its talks.
Tests pinned to schedule.json (RepositoryTest's 614 sessions / 40 rooms / 558 details, ScheduleRulesTest's catOf/seriesOf per session) must exclude event == 'colocated' or be updated.

fieldNotes.event: Always 'colocated' (the CNCF-hosted co-located events schedule, Sessionize event ayajbd6b). These ids are NOT in the main KubeCon Sessionize event (uo948i5p): never live-fetch them from there. Use colocated_details.json's 'details', which is complete.
fieldNotes.coloEvent: Key of the event (in 'events') this session belongs to. Set for every talk and for a break that belongs to one event only. null for shared breaks and experiences.
fieldNotes.coloEvents: Every event whose agenda includes this session: [coloEvent] for talks, all tagged events for breaks, [] for experiences. An event's agenda = the sessions whose coloEvents contain its key, ordered by start. Co-located breaks are timed per event (staggered), and none coincides with schedule.json's Monday break rows (checked by the script), which belong to the Hyatt Project Lightning Talks: show co-located breaks only inside their events' cards. The Evening Reception is [] on purpose although the source tags it with all 11 events: it is open to every co-located attendee and is an ordinary time-block session.
fieldNotes.format: 'Breakout', 'Panel', 'Lightning talk' or 'Keynote'. null when Sessionize gives none (welcome/closing remarks, breaks).
fieldNotes.level: 'Any level', 'Beginner', 'Intermediate' or 'Advanced'. null when not given.
fieldNotes.sponsored: true for sponsored talks (Sessionize subtopic 'Sponsored'; all are short keynotes).
fieldNotes.topic: The talk's topic within its event (e.g. 'Progressive Delivery'). null when none.
fieldNotes.slidesUrl: Uploaded slides (as in schedule.json; the details sheet's Slides link). null when none.
fieldNotes.description: Always null on sessions, as for KubeCon sessions in schedule.json. Descriptions and speaker taglines are in colocated_details.json (details.json's shape).
fieldNotes.room: A rooms.json code, or a code in this file's 'rooms' (position-less places such as foyers). The Evening Reception's 'Lower & Upper Mezzanine' is UM (shown as 'Upper Mezzanine').
fieldNotes.events: One per CNCF-hosted co-located event, alphabetical. start/end/halfDay describe the talks (first talk start to last talk end, Welcome/Closing Remarks included): use them for the card's hours and its 'finished', never the placeholder's times (several differ by a few minutes). Agenda breaks can run past end (e.g. CiliumCon's and FluxCon's lunches start as the event ends). supersedes = the schedule.json placeholder session id this event replaces (don't show both). infoUrl = that placeholder's official listing. pageUrl = the event's LF page. passNote = the placeholder's note.
fieldNotes.anthropicSpeakers: Anthropic colleagues speaking at the co-located events (see _rules). Add them to schedule.json's anthropicSpeakers at load: hasAnthropic() checks names at runtime, so the precomputed hasAnthropicSpeaker alone does nothing.
fieldNotes.omitted: Source sessions intentionally left out, with the reason.
